column1: # Measured tests of the split packages of ci/go_test_splits.tsv (CHAOS-13668): package<TAB>TestName<TAB>seconds. A go-quality test
# leg cuts a split package's names into its parts by these rows (ci/go_race_shard.awk cut()): a measured name longest first onto the
# lightest part, any other name by a hash of its own name, so adding or removing an unmeasured test moves no other test. The plan
# weighs a part by its rows plus an even share of what the rows leave of the package row in ci/go_test_weights.tsv.
# A row is the LARGER of the warm and the cold value (CHAOS-13730). Both are round(W * e/E): e = the test's top-level elapsed (cold: the
# largest elapsed of the test and its subtests, as a parallel subtest's time is not in its parent's line), E = the summed e of the tests
# of one go test of the package in that run, W = that go test's `ok` seconds (warm: the package row of ci/go_test_weights.tsv).
# - warm: the go-test-timings-test-K artifacts (go-quality.yml) of 4 successful go-quality push runs on main at 10 test legs
# - cold: the test legs of go-quality run 6221 (a go.sum change: the test-result cache missed), one go test per split package and leg.
# Rows: every listed test of 2 s or more warm or 10 s or more cold, and each package's heaviest tests up to its part count (no part can be empty).
# A row must name a test `go test -list` reports: renaming or removing a measured test needs its row edited in the same change
# (the leg and internal/cigates/testshard fail otherwise). Refresh: the same reduction over newer runs; values only cost balance.
